name: Lexicon SEO
description: Hosted MCP for technical SEO and AI-visibility audits. Start audits, read reports, list issues, verify fixes, check citations, and draft content refreshes. Words matter.
author: Lexicon SEO

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List this account's saved monitoring sites and the sites it has audited.

tools.name: start_audit
tools.description: Start a read-only audit of one public site. Uses one audit from this month's allowance and the same URL checks, page cap, and subscription checks as the dashboard. After the allowance, send confirm true to spend the quoted credit amount.

url.description: Public website URL. The audit runs on the site origin.

confirm.description: Required only after the monthly allowance. True spends the quoted credits.

tools.name: get_audit_status
tools.description: Status, pages crawled so far, and score for an audit on this account.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: The stored audit report as Markdown (the same export as the dashboard) or JSON.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: Issues on a stored report, grouped by code. Optional severity is critical, warning, or info. P0, P1, and P2 select those same three levels.

severity.description: Optional: critical, warning, info, P0, P1, or P2.

tools.name: get_fix
tools.description: Developer fix steps for one issue code, using the same guidance text as the Markdown export.

report_id.description: Optional audit id. When set, affected URLs come from that report.

tools.name: verify_fix
tools.description: Fetch one public page and report whether that issue code is still present. This does not use an audit. Site-wide codes such as robots.txt are refused.

issue_code.description: Issue code to recheck on that page.

tools.name: get_monitoring
tools.description: Latest stored diff and regressions for one saved monitoring site.

site.description: Id of a monitoring site saved on this account. A host or URL for one of those sites also works.

tools.name: get_citations
tools.description: Citation questions and answer-readiness checks stored on a report. This does not run a new search.

tools.name: extra_citation
tools.description: Ask one citation question past the plan allowance. Returns the price first. Send confirm true to spend credits. Does not publish anything.

confirm.description: True spends the quoted credits. Omit it to see the price.

tools.name: refresh_page
tools.description: Draft a title, meta description, and H1 for one page from a finished audit on this account. Business also drafts one added section. Uses one content refresh from this month's allowance. After the allowance, send confirm true to spend the quoted credits. Does not publish the page. The same page is not drafted again for 30 days.

url.description: A page URL from that audit.

confirm.description: Required only after the monthly allowance. True spends the quoted credits.

tools.name: get_refresh
tools.description: Read a stored content refresh draft. Does not call the model or use the monthly allowance. Omit url to list drafts stored on the report.
